finalText:
**The build is green again.**

One real error was hiding in the noise. `src/core/settings.js` used a bare `retries` that was never declared, so the link step threw `ReferenceError: retries is not defined`. It now reads `env.retries` and falls back to a new `DEFAULT_RETRIES` constant of `3`.

Build exits 0 with 3 warnings, 0 errors. Those three warnings are separate, smaller issues:

| Code | What it says |
| --- | --- |
| `W1042` | `src/legacy/adapter.js` uses the retired `crypto.createCipher` |
| `W2213` | `formatLegacyDate` in `src/utils/format.js` is exported but unused |
| `W3307` | `src/core/graph.js` and `src/state/tracker.js` import each other |

Say the word and I'll clear those too.
